_comment: Logic derived from FINISHED IDP drawings (Stratford 73.1163 + ExampleIDP 73.1142). Companion to finished-idp-anatomy.md. Encodes the drawing conventions the extractor should apply/validate so the workbook renders into correct IDP sheets.

control_discrete.signal: PER-PROJECT (learned; BLU or RED vary by project, do not hard-default)

power_3phase.note: parallel/multi-conductor feeder renders as 3 phase landings, not raw conductor count

type_normalization._comment: Real workbooks contain off-dropdown Type values; normalize to the legal domain (decision: normalize everything to dropdown).
type_normalization.fold_ground_into_group: GROUND/GND rows are folded into the conduit's primary group (add GRN color); no standalone GROUND type row is emitted.

validation_rules: Every conduit that should get a sheet must have >=1 FillIndex row.
POWER 3-phase should have 3 phase connections + a separate ground; phase colors per color_conventions.
Analog instrument = TSP pair (Wire Ct 1) + a power pair; shield noted separately.
S/D symbols must be legal dropdown blocks (enforced by lisa_contract).
